parameters: Defaults define this teaching task; capabilities remain parameterized. Unsupported conditions must be rejected or clarified.

semantics.purchase: original approved W03 paid/refund semantics; last effective purchase requires paid_cents > refund_cents
semantics.multiple_stores: retain relations; deduplicate per store and company independently
semantics.POS_only_registration: unknown; retain company members/orders; store range notice without per-store enumeration or confirmed nonmembership
semantics.operational_exclusion: confirmed employee/abnormal identity excluded from recommendations; suspected/unknown retained for verification; source data and historic account metrics preserved

contact_rules.same_person: merge evidence from every verified source account
contact_rules.unspecified_channel: report per-channel constraints; do not choose telephone

action_boundary: read-only analysis and manual review suggestions; no contact, coupon or label execution
